BSM browse by type volume/amplification amplification treble booster browse by enclosure pedal BSM FassBender Fuzz Machine Published on September 13, 2005 BSM treble boost pedal Controls Vol Fuzz (switch) (footswitch) Information BSM The BSM Faßbender is a gimmick version of the gorgeous FuzzBender model, custom-made for a very special german customer. Beside the different label under the hood it´s a 100% pure FuzzBender with all of it´s features, so please click there to get more detailed technical information. The funny name is sport-related and is dealing with the name of a very famous and well known german TV sports moderator, commentating countless soccer games in the past. If you want to know more of this funny story, Mr. Bernd C. Meiser would be happy to tell you.
